organic.title: What Is Zeno’s Paradox? - Science ABC
organic.snippet: Zeno's Dichotomy Paradox (the Race Course) claims motion is impossible because crossing any distance needs infinite half-steps. The modern resolution: the geometric series 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/8 + ... converges to exactly 1, an idea that helped seed calculus and the theory of limits.
